svg.title: ByteHunter verdict anatomy
svg.desc: An uploaded file is checked against a SHA-256 cache, parsed with LIEF into a 2,381-value vector and scored by LightGBM, or by a heuristic scorer when no LightGBM model loads; that single score maps to SAFE, SUSPICIOUS or MALICIOUS, while SHAP, Random Forest and Logistic Regression comparison, an XGBoost family classifier and an import-name lookup only annotate the result, which is stored in SQLite for history and PDF reports.
svg.text: ANNOTATES THE RESULT · NEVER CHANGES THE VERDICT
same thresholds for model or heuristic score
VERIFIED LIMITS · FOUND IN CODE, NOT STATED IN THE README
The vector is a custom layout padded to 2,381, not EMBER’s published feature
order, and imports are hashed with Python’s per-process hash(). Not validated.
Without ember_model_2018 the heuristic score is used, but the response
The API response drops shap_features and warning_signs, so the dashboard’s
SHAP chart does not render; SHAP reaches users only as grouped text.
Exact name matching: RegSetValueEx, URLDownloadToFile and InternetOpenUrl
lack the A/W suffix real imports carry, so those three never match.
